notes.title: First Steam Patch Now Live!
notes.notes:
First Steam Patch Now Live!Hey everyone,Our first Steam patch for Hungry Horrors is now live!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45178714/4d2ec4b265d1d6c5138e2f7f771cf49a19066122.png"]


🍽️ Early Translations
You can now try the demo in:

Japanese

Korean

Simplified Chinese

Traditional Chinese

Spanish

Brazilian Portuguese

Polish

Ukrainian

Russian



⚠️ These translations are very early drafts. Many lines are still unedited, inconsistent, or just plain wrong. We are working through them, and your feedback helps a lot.

👉 Send translation feedback
[hr][/hr]



🔥 Feature Highlights


🗺️ The bog biome is now revealed after completing the demo

📊 A run summary screen now appears when you die, showing stats and items you unlocked

📦 Unlock popups now trigger properly when gaining new items

♻️ You can reroll buffs in exchange for gold

🧠 In-battle tooltips and reminders help explain what’s happening

🧂 Dish info is now viewable during battle

🎮 Full keyboard-only controls are now supported


[hr][/hr]

🛠️ Improvements


👣 Princess' footsteps now have sound

📍 Notification when entering a new biome

🧱 Floor visuals raised slightly for better clarity


[hr][/hr]

🐞 Key Fixes


🗨️ Speech bubbles now appear more centrally

🧾 Tooltips no longer cut off in loot chests with 4 or more items

🍽️ Turn-skipping effects now properly skip the turn

🚪 Runs can’t be abandoned from the kitchen or tutorial

🌐 CJK fonts now wrap correctly thanks to bundled text server data

🧹 Plus a whole bunch of smaller bug fixes based on your feedback



Full patch notes: Read on our website


[hr][/hr]


We know this patch took a little longer than expected. Since releasing the demo, we’ve had a few surprises: an earthquake, a broken arm, and a lot of cockroaches.

You can read the full chaos report here: Developer blog


[hr][/hr]


We’re now back on track and plan to update the game regularly.

The next patch will focus more on balance and new features, so your feedback really matters.



📩 Send feedback here

🐾 Or join us on Discord



Thanks for playing. We’re reading everything and cooking up plenty more.


[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Hungry Horrors Dev Update #1: Monsters, Myths, and Meals!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 🎉 Welcome to Hungry Horrors’ very first update! 👋 We’re so excited to share what we’ve been working on and give you a glimpse into what’s next for the game.

So… What Is Hungry Horrors?

Hungry Horrors is our debut game—an indie roguelite deck-building adventure where you take on the role of a princess who must cook traditional dishes like Cranachan, Stargazy Pie, and Boxty to please mythical monsters. Each monster has a specific taste, and your goal is to serve the right dish to keep them happy… or at least full!🍳

You’ll meet creatures like Jenny Greenteeth from England 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿, Dullahan from Ireland 🇮🇪, Baobhan Sith from Scotland 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿, and Afanc from Wales 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁷󠁬󠁳󠁿. Each monster has its own preferences and quirks. It’s a game where folklore, strategy, and a dash of humour come together in a roguelite deck-building package. 


Who Are We?

We’re Clumsy Bear Studio, a small indie game development team based in London. Our team consists of two passionate creators: Scott, who handles all the programming and art, and Jerzy, who focuses on game design, marketing, and making sure everything runs smoothly.

Hungry Horrors is our first big project, and we’ve poured a lot into making this game unique, fun, and rooted in the rich folklore of the British and Irish Isles. 📖

Watch Our First Trailer!

We’re thrilled to share the announcement trailer for Hungry Horrors with you! 🎥 It feels surreal to finally show it off on Steam—it’s been quite the journey to get here, and we hope you enjoy what we’ve been cooking up. Check it out below! 👇

[previewyoutube=jOV7f-G-pic;full][/previewyoutube]

What’s Next?

It’s been exactly one month since we launched our Steam page, and we’re blown away by the support we’ve received so far. 💖 If you haven’t yet, please consider wishlisting Hungry Horrors on Steam. It helps us get more visibility and lets you stay up to date with the latest news.

And here’s the exciting part: the demo is coming soon! We’re currently putting the finishing touches on it, and we can’t wait for you to try it out. Keep an eye out for more updates as we get closer to the demo release. 🎮✨

Follow Us for Updates!

We’ll be sharing more updates, dev logs, and sneak peeks into the world of Hungry Horrors, so make sure to follow us on Steam to stay in the loop! Got questions about the game, the demo, or just want to chat? Come join the discussions! 💬 We’d love to hear from you.

Thank you for being a part of this journey—we’re so excited to have you along for the ride. 🎉🍽️
— Jerzy
